name: Babel Content Entities
description: Babel submodule: translate simple content entities (taxonomy terms, shortcuts, etc.) as UI strings through the Babel interface.
project_description: Submodule of Babel. Adds a derived 'content_entity' translation-type plugin (one derivative per admin-selected content entity type) so simple content entities — taxonomy terms, shortcuts, and similar — appear as UI strings in the Babel unified translation interface. Translations are written back to the entity as content_translation entity translations. An admin selects which content entity types (and, per type, which bundles) are exposed on a settings page.
